newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-TAXMAN AFTER ISRAEL SOCCER STAR OHANA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TAXMAN AFTER ISRAEL SOCCER STAR OHANA.

text.p: An Israeli court released Betar Jerusalem's international striker Eli Ohana on $19,000 bail on Sunday after he was detained by tax authorities, Israel's Itim news agency said.
It said Ohana was suspected of failing to declare some of his income as a professional soccer player.
Tel Aviv magistrates court Judge Nira Lidsky also barred Ohana from leaving the country for 180 days without first reporting his intention to leave to tax authorities, Itim said.
Ohana is an integral part of Israel's national squad preparing to take on Russia in a World Cup group five match in Moscow next week. The squad travels on Wednesday.
"This has been blown way out of proportion by the media," Ohana told reporters after leaving court.
"The taxmen have to do their job, this may take some time, but it will all be sorted out in the end and then it will be proved that I have done nothing wrong," he said.
